blurb: A technical-analysis practitioner active on X whose posts focus on chart-based setups across equities and other asset classes. The account's primary edge, as self-described, is the systematic application of Fibonacci retracement levels — particularly the 61.8%–65% 'golden pocket' zone — to identify high-probability reversals in trending instruments. Posts routinely feature annotated TradingView charts with multi-year lookback windows, emphasizing monthly and weekly timeframes over short-term noise. The account does not appear to operate a paid newsletter or research service; output is shared publicly. Little additional biographical detail is publicly verifiable.
credibility_note: Track record and identity are not publicly documented beyond the X account's own chart posts. The golden pocket framework cited is a legitimate and widely used technique in technical analysis, and the Lumentum example shown (status/2050795729271378383) is factually consistent with the stock's price history. As with all retrospective chart analysis, the selected example benefits from hindsight; readers should evaluate the broader hit rate independently before treating the method as a trading signal.
